text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I messed up! It really sucks getting injured…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: But not like it's crazy painful or anything. I can get back to training, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What? But I'm not. I'm saying I can do it.
choice_data_list: Well, so long as you don't overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Scaredy-cat much? I told you I'm fine.
choice_data_list: We're going to hit the books until you're back on your feet.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What?! That's what you mean by rest?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Or, to put it another way, you're saying the only way to get me studying is when I can't move, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: No way, pal! No way am I studying! I'll be back on the track in no time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan rests up and lets her injury heal properly.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! See, you get it! Wanna head to the track?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Crap… I guess… maybe it does still hurt. You gotta be kidding me. What a joke…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems she's not quite ready to get back to training. She needs to focus on her recovery.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: All right, how's this? No complaints, right?
choice_data_list: Let's keep going. But don't be reckless.
Let's keep going. But don't be reckless.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You're so stubborn. As if I could be reckless even if I wanted to with you watching over me like a hawk.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …Meh. I guess that's reassuring or whatever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Tosen Jordan makes a full recovery.
